entry_id.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
entry_id.why: The entry's key, a six-digit NAICS code and Census's description joined with '|' (111110|Soybean farming, field and seed production). Inferred, finetype labels it plain text at 0.45 confidence; it is an identifier, not prose. The label's pattern does not admit the '|' or the spaces, so describe widens it, and the overrides declare the shape.

code_description.label: representation.text.plain_text
code_description.why: Census's title for the national industry, such as Soybean Farming. Inferred, finetype labels it an entity name, an organisation's or product's name, which it is not; it is prose naming a kind of business. bls/soc_2018_titles nominates its code_description the same way.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: The NAICS edition, 2022, stored as text as every code list's and title index's release is. Inferred, finetype reads the four digits as a year and the descriptor would type the column as a year; the value names an edition, not a point in time.
